notes: Two BiLSTM arms on the current canonical split (TODO §3.6): arm A is the exact, unmodified sb.recognize.architectures.BiLSTM class fed base_v1 ME-126/xy raw landmarks (252-dim) -- a faithful re-baseline, since every registry BiLSTM run predates the 2026-09-16 split reset. Arm B is the new LandmarkBiLSTM (same fwd-last/bwd-first readout, plus the attention gate + generalized dims every other interp-track model has) fed features_curated's ME-126+xy+28-angle+relational pipeline (922-dim). Hyperparameters (hidden_size/num_layers/dropout/batch_size/lr/epochs/early-stopping) match gislr.training.json's shared block exactly, so the only difference between arms is the feature pipeline (and arm A's lack of an attention gate/proj layer, matching the production class precisely). Not part of ARCHS/the registry -- see sb.recognize.interp's module docstring for why. Both arms are OFFLINE-ONLY (bidirectional).
